title: Permian Resources Announces Strong Fourth Quarter 2025 Results and Provides Full Year 2026 Plan with Improved Capital Efficiency and Increased Base Dividend
summary: MIDLAND, Texas – Permian Resources Corporation (“Permian Resources” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PR) today announced its fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial and operational results and 2026 financial and operational plans. Fourth Quarter 2025 Financial and Operational Highlights Reported total average production of 401.5 MBoe/d, including 188.6 MBbls/d of oil, 102.1 MBbls/d of NGLs […]
